name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v2512: Accepting failures OR errors let an unrelated crash vouch for the join - an error means something else blew up, not that the census reached the patched rule. Errors are asserted empty now and only a genuine assertion failure counts, proven by a crash placed before the orphan check. The sentinel was also searched across the whole failure blob where it could appear in a traceback; it must appear in the orphan assertion own message, and that tightening immediately caught my own case mismatch.
